environment.description: Same Flask application deployed in EKS pod with HashiCorp Vault Agent sidecar using dynamic SMTP credential leasing. Vault SMTP secrets engine issues ephemeral credentials with a TTL of 60 seconds and max_ttl of 60 seconds. The Vault lease renewal is handled by the agent template with a renewal_buffer of 45s, meaning credentials rotate approximately every 15 seconds in practice. Additionally, the SMTP relay (internal Haraka MJS instance) enforces per-credential session binding: each credential issued by Vault is tagged with a nonce that the Haraka AUTH plugin validates against Vault's lease ID via the Vault API before accepting any RCPT TO command. If the lease is expired or revoked, the SMTP session is terminated mid-transaction. The credential rotation means any intercepted or replayed SMTP auth token becomes invalid within the rotation window, but the email header injection itself occurs BEFORE SMTP authentication in the application code path.
